title: Nvidia’s Stock Price Set to Drop After Investigation Into CEO Jensen Huang
summary: The chipmaker’s size and significance to the A.I. trade means that Jensen Huang’s admission of a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy could reverberate across Wall Street.
